title: kpv0(g): decide mypy CI contract and scope (105 errors)
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-kpv0. mypy reports ~105 errors (99 inherited, ~6 in convergence-changed aiocoap sites); mypy is currently NOT a CI command. Requires an explicit contract decision without broad ignores: either (1) mypy stays out of CI and the decision is documented (where? CI README / pyproject [tool.mypy] baseline scope), or (2) mypy enters CI scoped to a clean subset (e.g. src/lichen minus aiocoap stubs) with the 6 aiocoap findings fixed. Policy-level scope call — flag to Mark via bd human if ambiguous after surveying error distribution; do not mask with per-module ignore-all.
